text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is always a big event.
The
entrants are chosen by popular
vote, so the
lineup invariably ends up
being a who's who of
the best racers of
the year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this year, the atmosphere in the
stands is a
little different.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф is finally taking on
senior-year
racers... I can't wait to see
how she does!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Don't get your hopes up. Some of these
racers are
almost finished with their
careers. One of them's
gonna snag the
win, I figure.
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Still, she's the Emperor, right? She'll be
top three
for sure.
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're back. How's the mood out
there?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Haha... Are they now? How flattering.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on me. They hope that I will
measure
up favorably against the
seniors, as well as the
most talented of
my contemporaries.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But still, I have yet to capture their
hearts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф came second in the fan
vote,
losing out to a senior-year
Umamusume, and it
seems to be
weighing on her mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A simple poll cannot truly measure the
people's
faith in me, of course, but the
result does
symbolize my current
standing quite aptly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Many believe that the seniors'
experience
presents an obstacle that I
cannot hope to
overcome.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Which means that they doubt my
abilities. And
such doubts have only one
remedy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Let's show them how strong you really are!
